overview_description.description: Koala Go is a virtual classroom built from the ground up for online tutoring with kids — the use case Zoom and Google Meet weren't designed for. Its signature shared browser feature lets tutors and students share the same web page in real time, so worksheets, games, and reading materials work without screen-share gymnastics or kids juggling tabs. Additional features include AI-generated class notes, class recording, scheduling, and B2B tutoring businesses. Backed by Y Combinator (W22). Built-in whiteboard. Trusted by independent tutors.

product.name: Koala Go
product.description: An online teaching platform enabling interactive sessions with features like co-browser, whiteboard, and virtual playground for up to 4 students per session.

product.name: Koala Pro
product.description: A subscription plan offering unlimited co-browser use, unlimited activities, PDF/PPT uploads, student chat with translation, and 24/7 live support for online tutors.

product.name: Koala Business
product.description: A scalable solution for organizations with 25 or more tutors, featuring admin dashboards, teacher management, cloud recording, branding, lesson plan sharing, and optional custom development and API.
